articles.title: ActionAid tasks FG, stakeholders on stronger social protection to eradicate poverty
articles.summary:
ActionAid Nigeria has urged governments at all levels to strengthen social protection systems, stressing that access to decent housing, healthcare, education and sustainable livelihoods is critical to eradicating poverty. The organisation made the call at the 2026 International Day for the Eradication of Poverty celebration held at Offa Igbo Community I, Lagelu Local Government Area […]
The
articles.hausa_translation: ActionAid Nigeria ta bukaci gwamnatoci a duk matakin gwamnati da sauran stakeholders su karfafa tsarin kariyar zamantakewa, inda ta jaddada cewa samun gida mai kyau, aikin lafiya, ilimi da masu neman rayuwa mai dorewa shine muhimmi don kawar da talauci. Kungiyar ta yi kiran nan a wurin bikin 2026 Ranar Kasa ta Kawar da Talauci da aka yi a Offa Igbo Community I, Lagelu Local Government Area.
critical_questions: What specific, measurable policy commitments or funding allocations did governments pledge at this event, or is this mainly advocacy rhetoric?

Whose voices are missing—have affected communities in extreme poverty been consulted on what social protection actually means to them?

articles.title: AFCON 2027 Qualifier: Guinea-Bissau Snatch Late Draw Against Madagascar
articles.summary: Guinea-Bissau scored an 84th-minute equaliser to hold Madagascar to a 1-1 draw in their Africa Cup of Nations 2027 qualifying Group L encounter. Madagascar appeared set for victory after Warren Caddy broke the deadlock in the 59th minute, giving the hosts a 1-0 advantage. However, Guinea-Bissau fought back and restored parity six minutes from time […]
articles.hausa_translation: Guinea-Bissau ya sami gida a mintci na 84 don daukar jiya da Madagascar a 1-1 a gidan aiki na Africa Cup of Nations 2027. Madagascar ta nuna karfi bayan Warren Caddy ya samu gida a mintci na 59, amma Guinea-Bissau ta koma koli da daukar jiya a mintci na 84.

articles.title: Ghana End 37-Month AFCON Qualifying Winless Run; Ivory Coast, Senegal Win
articles.summary: Ghana ended a 37-month winless run in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying with a 2-0 victory over Somalia, while Ivory Coast, Senegal and the Democratic Republic of Congo recorded victories in Thursday’s matches. The four-time African champions secured their first Group C win in Essipong after suffering defeats to Ivory Coast and The Gambia in […]
articles.hausa_translation: Gana ta Tsokar Waje na Tsatsin Shekaru da Waje Rabin Shekaru a Gasar Africa Cup of Nations; Ivory Coast, da Senegal sun yi nasara. Gana ta kashe Somalia da rabo na 2-0 a ranar Alhamis, inda kuma Ivory Coast, Senegal, da Jamhuriyar Demokratikiyar Congo suka samu nasarori. Gabar da ta yi nasara hudu a Africa ta sami nasararta ta farko a rukunin C a Essipong bayan ta sha faɗaɗa daga Ivory Coast da Gambia.
critical_questions: Why did Ghana's previous AFCON qualifying campaigns fail over 37 months, and have structural issues in team management or coaching been addressed?
